summary: The likelihood of renewed large-scale US strikes on Iran has increased as military clashes escalate. Israel has intensified strikes on Hamas commanders and demolished a tunnel section in central Gaza that posed an immediate threat. In Iraq, a new command took over Jurf al-Sakhar with IRGC-backed militias deployed to pipelines, while Iran saw anti-aircraft fire and a launch in Isfahan.
key_points: The likelihood of renewed large-scale US strikes on Iran has increased in recent days as military clashes escalate, according to Western officials. (Source: Faytuks_Network/10229)
Israel has stepped up strikes on Hamas commanders as the terror group attempts to rebuild its ranks, indicating ongoing efforts to degrade Hamas's military capabilities. (Source: manniefabian/59557)
The IDF demolished a section of a Hamas tunnel adjacent to the Yellow Line in central Gaza that had crossed into the Israeli side and posed an immediate threat to forces. (Source: manniefabian/59558)
Shin Bet and IDF operatives arrested a Hamas activist in Kafr Tawas in the West Bank, suspected of promoting terror activities, in a covert operation. (Source: yediotnews25/138223)

In Iraq, a new command assumed control of Jurf al-Sakhar, deploying the Army, Federal Police, 2 PMF brigades, and Energy Police to secure pipelines, with IRGC-backed Kataib Hezballah also positioned there. (Source: shin_persian/12598)
Nearly 10 anti-aircraft shots were fired from Mount Sofeh in Isfahan, Iran, reflecting heightened air defense posture. (Source: shin_persian/12595)
A launch from the 15 Khordad garrison in Isfahan occurred with an uncertain object type, adding to the region's military activity. (Source: shin_persian/12593)

IT disruptions have impacted operations at a key facility in Georgia that supports Middle East-focused signals intelligence and cybersecurity operations, potentially affecting Iran-related surveillance. (Source: Faytuks_Network/10226)

sections.threat_assessment: The increased likelihood of US strikes on Iran, combined with Israeli strikes on Hamas and Iranian air defense activity, suggests a volatile escalation across multiple fronts. The deployment of IRGC-backed militias to Iraqi pipelines indicates continued proxy warfare and potential targeting of energy infrastructure. The tunnel demolition in Gaza shows Israel's proactive measures against Hamas's rebuilding efforts, while the arrest in the West Bank highlights ongoing security operations. These developments collectively point to a high risk of further confrontation.
sections.regional_response: Israel's intensified strikes and tunnel demolition demonstrate a commitment to neutralizing immediate threats from Hamas. The US increased strike likelihood signals potential external intervention against Iran. Iran's anti-aircraft fire and launches suggest a defensive posture amid perceived threats. Iraq's militia deployments reflect the ongoing influence of Iranian proxies in regional security dynamics. These actions are likely to provoke further responses from affected parties.
sections.intelligence_notes: The IT disruptions at the NSA's supporting facility in Georgia may degrade signals intelligence capabilities relevant to Middle East operations, potentially affecting real-time threat assessment. The simultaneous occurrences of Israeli strikes, Iranian air defense, and Iraqi militia movements indicate coordinated or reactive postures across the theater. Monitoring the Jurf al-Sakhar area and Isfahan for further military activity remains critical.
